status: Post hoc exploratory reanalysis of an already inspected cohort; not preregistered
cohort: All 24 paired training seeds 4301–4324; fixed 8192-decision policies
independent_unit: Paired training seed; phases and target angles are repeated evaluations
extended_family: All remaining contrasts emitted by the fixed analysis script, jointly Holm-corrected; global Holm over every new contrast also reported
tests: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip test; bootstrap and t intervals, paired t and sign tests as sensitivities
original_statistics: Retain original primary four-test and secondary 32-test correction families unchanged

dynamic_endpoints.normalized_iae: Mean absolute heading error / absolute target angle, at 0.31–2.00 s
dynamic_endpoints.settling_time_s: Time after 0.30 s of final entry into <=10 degree error and up_z>=0.8, remaining inside through 2.00 s for at least 0.20 s; unresolved episodes assigned horizon 1.70 s
dynamic_endpoints.overshoot_fraction: Maximum positive excess of direction-aligned unwrapped rotation over absolute target, divided by absolute target
dynamic_endpoints.wrongway_fraction: Fraction of 0.31–2.00 s with direction-aligned unwrapped rotation < 0
dynamic_endpoints.late_yaw_rms: RMS of trailing 100 ms averaged yaw rate during 1.51–2.00 s, rad/s
dynamic_endpoints.turn_command_variation: Sum of absolute successive changes in turn command (action channel 1), macro samples 0.32–2.00 s

bilateral_endpoints.worst_direction_error: Maximum of positive and negative mean terminal errors within each seed
bilateral_endpoints.direction_gap: Absolute difference between positive and negative mean terminal errors within each seed
bilateral_endpoints.bilateral_10deg: Fraction of matched phase and absolute-angle pairs with terminal error <=10 degrees in BOTH directions, no physical failures
bilateral_endpoints.bilateral_success: Fraction of matched phase and absolute-angle pairs passing original sustained walking-angle success in BOTH directions
bilateral_endpoints.joint_worst_error: Mean maximum terminal error across matched positive/negative episodes

sensitivity: Bilateral threshold curve 5,10,15,20,30 degrees is descriptive, with no threshold selection or additional tests
claim_boundary: No unilateral-only training arm exists in this cohort. Direction-stratified evaluation cannot identify a cost of bilateral training or a learning-speed difference.

figure_contract.question: Does Adult improve directional accuracy, joint bilateral coverage, or control smoothness after identical bilateral training?
figure_contract.claim: Show the supported control-smoothness advantage and quantify the uncertain direction-specific accuracy trend
figure_contract.uncertainty: 95% t confidence intervals over training seeds; exploratory pointwise intervals, not simultaneous
